results.pair_summary: Doc A is the executable Common Lisp implementation of the IR Stream module, while Doc B is its formal specification defining types, operations, invariants, and lifecycle constraints. They describe identical functionality with high semantic alignment.
results.integration_rationale: In the Delta3 Kernel architecture, formal specifications (.spec) serve as verifiable contracts for runtime components. Doc B defines critical invariants (INV-S1..S4) and lifecycle rules required for correctness proofs and verification tooling, while Doc A provides the executable logic. Both artifacts are necessary and complementary; merging them would obscure the distinction between implementation details and formal requirements.
